newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Retailer Yantai Hualian approved to list A shares.
newsitem.headline: Retailer Yantai Hualian approved to list A shares.

text.p: Yantai Hualian Commercial Building Co Ltd has received approval from the China Securities Regulatory Commission to list 16.72 million A shares in Shanghai soon, a company spokesman said on Friday.
The A shares were issued at face value of one yuan per share in 1989, the spokesman told the Hong Kong-based newsletter China Securities Bulletin.
Hualian's profit forecast and record would be made public in a listing notice to be released soon, the official said. Shanghai Guotai Securities has been named Hualian's listing promoter, he said.

Hualian now has total share capital of 54.30 million shares, including 26.88 million state shares, 10.70 million legal person shares and 16.72 million A shares. The company is based in the city of Yantai in eastern Shandong province.
